study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Floris et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2021
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Atypical Brain Asymmetry in Autism - A Candidate for Clinically Meaningful Stratification

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to estimate separate normative models of grey matter laterality at each voxel. The model used a covariance function combining linear and non-linear terms with automatic relevance determination parameters. 10-fold cross-validation was used for model evaluation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we estimated a normative brain aging model at each gray matter laterality voxel by using Gaussian process regression (53), a Bayesian nonparametric interpolation method that yields coherent measures of predictive confidence in addition to point estimates
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter voxelwise laterality index calculated from modulated warped gray matter images. The laterality index was calculated at each voxel using the formula: 2(Inref - Iref)/(Inref + Iref), where Inref is non-reflected and Iref is reflected gray matter intensity images. Positive values indicate rightward asymmetry, negative values indicate leftward asymmetry.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We derived gray matter voxelwise laterality values for each subject and modeled individual deviations from the normative pattern of brain laterality across age using normative modeling.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Image Preprocessing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, sex, and site were used as covariates in the Gaussian process regression model to predict gray matter asymmetry. The model was trained on neurotypical individuals aged 6-30 years across 5 different acquisition sites.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model at each voxel on the neurotypical cohort using age, sex, and site as covariates to predict gray matter asymmetry
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Floris2021.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling
